AGENDA
  CITY COUNCIL MEETINGS
  OCTOBER 1, 2019
REGULAR MEETING
  6:00 PM
  NORWALK CITY HALL/COUNCIL CHAMBERS
  AND VIA VIDEOCONFERENCE

  Margarita L. Rios, Mayor
  Luigi Vernola, Vice Mayor
  Tony Ayala, Councilmember
  Jennifer Perez, Councilmember
  Leonard Shryock, Councilmember
 Public Comment: Comments may be made in person, submitted via email at: publiccomments@norwalkca.gov, or through
 the video conference during the designated time on any item on the agenda or on any other matter within the jurisdiction
 subject to the rules of decorum described in Norwalk Municipal Code §2.08.020. The maximum time allowed is three
 minutes.

 Pursuant to provisions of the Brown Act, no action may be taken on a matter unless it is listed on the agenda, or unless
 certain emergency or special circumstances exist. The City Council may direct staff to investigate and/or schedule certain
 matters for consideration at a future City Council meeting.

 Please adhere to the following procedures when addressing the Council:

  • Comments should be limited to 3 minutes or less.
  • Comments should be directed to the City Council as a whole and not directed to individual Councilmembers.

 Americans with Disabilities Act: In compliance with the ADA, if you need special assistance to participate in a City
 meeting or other services offered by this City, please contact the City Clerk's Department, (562) 929-5720. Assisted listening
 devices are available at this meeting. Ask the City Clerk if you desire to use this device. Upon request, the agenda and
 documents in the agenda packet can be made available in appropriate alternative formats to persons with a disability.
 Notification of at least 48 hours prior to the meeting or time when services are needed will assist the City staff in assuring
 that reasonable arrangements can be made to provide accessibility to the meeting or service.

 Note: Any writings and/or documents provided to a majority of the City Council regarding any item on this agenda after it
 has been posted will also be made available for public inspection.

 Writings and/or documents are available for inspection in the City Clerk's Department, City Hall, 12700 Norwalk Boulevard
 during regular business hours, 8:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m., Monday - Thursday and 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., every other Friday;
 telephone (562) 929-5720. You may also contact the City Clerk via e mail at recordsrequests@norwalkca.gov.

 CONSENT CALENDAR

Consent calendar items are considered routine matters which may be enacted by one motion and roll call vote.
Any item may be removed from the consent calendar and considered separately by City Council.

  1.  MEETING MINUTES – Staff recommends City Council approve the minutes of the meeting of
  September 17, 2019. 825-04

  Minutes

  2.  PAYROLL – Staff recommends City Council approve the payroll for the period August 25, 2019 –
  September 7, 2019, in the total amount of $961,262.17. 630

  Report

  3.  COMMERCIAL DEMANDS – Staff recommends City Council approve the warrant register for the
  period September 11, 2019 – September 24, 2019, in the total amount of $1,925,827.11. 640

  Report

  4.  CLAIM AGAINST THE CITY - Staff recommends City Council deny the claim filed by Rene Rosales.
  830-18

  Report

  5.  PLANNING COMMISSION SYNOPSIS – SEPTEMBER 25, 2019 - No action is required unless the
  City Council elects to review the decision of the Planning Commission on those items where the
  Commission’s action was final. 320

  Synopsis

  6.  RESOLUTION NO. 19-55 – DESTRUCTION OF OBSOLETE RECORDS - Staff recommends City
  Council adopt Resolution No. 19-55, A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
  NORWALK AUTHORIZING THE DESTRUCTION OF CERTAIN RECORDS IN THE CITY CLERK
  DEPARTMENT. 870-02

  Report

  7.  CONFIRM EMERGENCY REPAIR WORK – NORWALK MUNICIPAL WATER SYSTEM - 11904 166th
  STREET, ARTESIA; 14320 ALBURTIS AVENUE, PIONEER BOULEVARD AND ROSECRANS
  AVENUE, 14022 MAIDSTONE AVENUE, AND 15500 BLACKBURN AVENUE - Staff recommends City
  Council confirm emergency repair work for five locations completed by Steven Doreck Equipment
  Rentals, Inc., in the amount of $55,753.32. 955

  Report

  8.  CONFIRM EMERGENCY REPAIR WORK – 14015 ELMCROFT AVENUE - Staff recommends City
  Council confirm emergency repair work completed by Precision Pipeline, Inc., in the amount of
  $5,548.12. 955

  Report

  9.  PROJECT NO. 7357- ACCEPT WORK FOR THE INSTALLATION OF CHAIN LINK FENCING ON
  ACQUIRED TANK FARM PROPERTY ADJACENT TO HOLIFIELD PARK, ENGINEERS REPORT NO.
  19-22 - Staff recommends City Council accept the work of Alcorn Fence Company of Sun Valley in the
  amount of $34,069.50 for Project No. 7357, the installation of chain link fencing on acquired Tank Farm
  property adjacent to Holifield Park. 1005-04-7357

  Report

  10. PROJECT NO. 7923 – APPROVAL OF PLANS AND SPECIFICATIONS AND AUTHORIZATION TO
  ADVERTISE FOR LOCAL STREETS REHABILITATION – ENGINEER’S REPORT NO. 19-16 - Staff
  recommends City Council approve plans and specifications for the Local Streets Rehabilitation Project
   No. 7923 - Community Development Block Grant eligible neighborhood bounded by Rosecrans
  Avenue, Pioneer Boulevard, Mapledale Avenue, and Jersey Avenue; authorize advertisement for bids
  and set a bid opening date of October 31, 2019. 1005-04-7923

  Report

  11. RESOLUTION NO. 19-56 – BUDGET AMENDMENT- PROJECT NO. 7229 – AWARD OF CONTRACT
  FOR CONSTRUCTION MANAGEMENT AND INSPECTION SERVICES FOR THE TRAFFIC SIGNAL
  AND CURB RAMP IMPROVEMENTS – STUDEBAKER ROAD BETWEEN ALONDRA BOULEVARD
  AND ROSECRANS AVENUE, FEDERAL PROJECT NO. HSIPL-5347(39), CITY PROJECT NO. 7229,
  ENGINEER’S REPORT NO. 19-24 – Staff recommends City Council:

  a.  adopt Resolution No. 19-56, A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
  NORWALK AUTHORIZING AN AMENDMENT TO THE FISCAL YEAR 2019/20 ADOPTED
  BUDGET TO TRANSFER AVAILABLE MEASURE “R” FUNDS TO PROJECT NO. 7229 -
  TRAFFIC SIGNAL AND CURB RAMP IMPROVEMENTS – STUDEBAKER ROAD BETWEEN
  ALONDRA BOULEVARD AND ROSECRANS AVENUE, in the amount of $153,045; and

  b.  approve an agreement with GK & Associates of Diamond Bar, in an amount not to exceed
  $111,680 for the construction management and inspection services for Project No. 7229, Traffic
  Signal and Curb Ramp Improvements – Studebaker Road Between Alondra Boulevard and
  Rosecrans Avenue; and authorize the City Manager to execute the agreement and amendments,
  provided there is funding in the budget, on behalf of the City, in a form approved by the City
  Attorney. 610/1005-04-7229

  Report

  12. AGREEMENTS – NORWALK-LA MIRADA UNIFIED SCHOOL DISTRICT MASTER RECREATIONAL
  USE AGREEMENT AND INDIVIDUAL SITE RECREATIONAL USE AGREEMENTS FOR RAMONA
  PARK, NEW RIVER PARK, LOS ALISOS MIDDLE SCHOOL AND DOLLAND ELEMENTARY
  SCHOOL - Staff recommends City Council approve agreements with the Norwalk-La Mirada Unified
  School District for an updated Master Recreational Use Agreement and Individual Site Recreational
  Use Agreements for Ramona Park, New River Park, Los Alisos Middle School, and Dolland Elementary
  School for a period of ten years with an option to extend for five years; and authorize the City Manager
  to execute the agreements and any amendments provided there is funding in the budget, on behalf of
  the City, in forms approved by the City Attorney. 530-04/530-04-02

  Report

APPOINTMENTS

  13. ADVISORY BODIES - Staff recommends City Council make appointments to fill the vacancies on the
  various City advisory bodies. 200

  Report

HEARING

THIS ITEM IS BEING CONTINUED AND IT WILL BE RE-NOTICED IF IT NEEDS TO RETURN TO CITY
COUNCIL.

  14. RESOLUTION NO. 19-60 - APPEAL OF PROPERTY MAINTENANCE AND BUILDING
  REHABILITATION APPEALS BOARD DECISION - ABATEMENT OF A PUBLIC NUISANCE ON THE

  OF THE CITY OF NORWALK SETTING FORTH ITS FINDINGS OF FACT AND DECISION RELATIVE

  12215 SUMMER AVENUE, ASSESSOR’S PARCEL NO. 8023-006-014, NORWALK, CALIFORNIA.
  305-03-07 RESOLUTIONS

  Report

  15. RESOLUTION NO. 19-57 - APPROVING THE CITY OF NORWALK COYOTE COEXISTENCE AND
   MANAGEMENT PLAN - Staff recommends City Council adopt Resolution No. 19-57, A RESOLUTION
  OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF NORWALK APPROVING THE CITY OF NORWALK
  COYOTE COEXISTENCE AND MANAGEMENT PLAN. 735-09

  Report

  16. RESOLUTION NO. 19-61 - AMENDING THE FISCAL YEAR 2019/20 SALARY SCHEDULE - Staff
  recommends City Council adopt RESOLUTION NO. 19-61, A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL
  OF THE CITY OF NORWALK AMENDING THE SALARY SCHEDULE FOR FISCAL YEAR 2019/20
  FOR THE GENERAL, HOURLY, AND MANAGEMENT UNIT EMPLOYEES. 135-03

  Report

REPORTS

  17. AGREEMENT AMENDMENT NO. 9 - WATER SYSTEM SERVICES - Staff recommends City Council
  approve Amendment No. 9 to the agreement with Bucknam and Associates to provide additional staff
  to serve as Senior Civil Engineer, add the additional scope of work, and compensation in the amount of
  $131,400; and authorize the City Manager to execute the amendment, on behalf of the City, in a form
  approved by the City Attorney. 1070-05

  Report

ORAL COMMUNICATIONS

ADJOURNMENT

I hereby certify under penalty of perjury under the laws of the State of California that the foregoing agenda was posted
on the City Hall bulletin board not less than 72 hours prior to the meeting. Dated September 27, 2019.

Theresa Devoy, CMC
City Clerk
